== Published English Original Virtual Set 8 wording ==
The remaster removes the movement surcharge and the written once-per-game Scum And Villainy limit. It grants conditional full attrition immunity and weapon/Interrupt protection with an alien leader. The battle action uses 1 Force on one other eligible alien, replacing loss of 2 Force for all eligible aliens.
